behaviours.note: down is set only by a press that lands on a Held/Repeat/Delayed record; g_mouseLeftDown rises on any WM_LBUTTONDOWN (004b0000.c:2115), so a press begun off the table and dragged onto a kind-2 record pulses in the original and not here.
ramp restart matches; the original's +0x0E survives 3 frames of the +0x0D countdown (00400000.c:7486-7489) before it zeroes, ours zeroes at the leave.

Press::event answers DoubleClick with Some(i) for a kind-2 record, press_event drops it and SetupScreen::handle has no DoubleClick arm, so the second press of a double click acts nowhere; Hotspot_Test fires on g_mouseLeftDoubleClick at 00400000.c:7880-7889.
